title: p2y5.1: Rust gateway: mesh-to-internet IPv6 forwarding path
description: lichen-gateway receives packets from LoRa mesh but does not forward them to upstream interfaces. Implement: when a received IPv6 packet's destination is not a mesh node (not in RPL routing table), forward it to the backhaul interface (Yggdrasil tun or Tailscale). Requires: routing table lookup, tun/tap write.
